title: Developing the Next Generation — CSK Youth Cricket Pathway
author: CSK Media & Youth Staff
excerpt: Young players from local schools start training and playing alongside senior CSK players, building skills, confidence, and discipline.
content:
As Cayman Super Kings continues to grow, the club is also committed to developing the next generation of cricketers.

Young players from local schools have started training and playing alongside CSK players, giving them the opportunity to experience a competitive cricket environment from an early age.

Pathway to Competitive Leather-Ball Cricket

Through regular training, match experience, and interaction with experienced players, these young cricketers are able to develop their skills, confidence, discipline, and understanding of the game.

CSK is proud to provide a pathway for aspiring young players to learn, grow, and pursue their ambitions in cricket, with the hope of helping them progress towards playing competitive and professional cricket in the future.

title: CSK Secures Knockout Berth in Historic T10 Tournament Campaign
author: CSK Media Team
excerpt: Captain Rahul Garg's powerplay assault and Chris Balraj's leg-spin heroics send CSK into the playoff knockout rounds.
content:
In one of the proudest moments in club history, Cayman Super Kings have officially secured their place in the knockout stages of the T10 championship.

Under the composed leadership of skipper Rahul Garg, CSK dismantled the opposition with an electric batting display. Rahul set the tone with a rapid 53 off 42 deliveries before Ravneet Verma (3/16) and Rajasekhara Kalagotla (3/6) locked down the chase with unplayable spin bowling.

Founding leader Christopher Balraj and team manager Majin Paul praised the team's relentless work ethic: 'From our humble pre-COVID origins to competing in the knockouts, this team embodies the true spirit of Cayman cricket.'

title: CSK Stars Shine on the Global Stage & National Squad
author: CSK Media Team
excerpt: Rahul Garg and Christopher Balraj represent CSK in international T10 leagues alongside global cricket icons.
content:
The growth of Cayman Super Kings continues to make waves on the international cricket landscape.

Captain Rahul Garg and former skipper Christopher Balraj both featured in premier international T10 leagues. Rahul shared dressing rooms with cricket legends David Warner, Carlos Brathwaite, Alex Hales, Shakib Al Hasan, and Thisara Perera, while Chris competed under the captaincy of Shahbaz Nadeem.

Furthermore, Rahul Garg and Gokul Krishnan have been selected for the Cayman Islands national team training squad as they prepare for upcoming international tournaments.
